question: In the scene involving vs. Volcanica, I was surprised by how many new terms related to magic theory came flying out during the exchange between Roswaal and Ezzo. Were these just improvised by you for that one scene, or have you actually worked out a systematic theory for them as part of the setting?
answer:
I knew someone was absolutely going to ask about it, so when I first wrote it, they were improvised, but afterward, just in case I was asked about them, I came up with a rough idea of “this is probably the kind of theory behind it.” (laughs)

Ezzo-san also appears in the newly released Short Story Collection 14. He's a character I really like, and you get to see the other factions besides Subaru and the Emilia camp having fun and doing their own thing, so I'd be very happy if you checked it out.
